title: Guide on Sales Tax Exemption under Items 5, 6 and 7, Schedule B of the Sales Tax (Persons Exempted from Payment of Tax) Order 2018
summary: New RMCD guide (Malay version only) for manufacturers on the sales tax exemption, added by P.U.(A) 303/2026 from 1 September 2026, for the import, transport and purchase of raw materials approved by the Minister of Finance for manufacturing animal feed (Item 5), fertiliser (Item 6) and pesticides (Item 7). It lists the approved raw materials with tariff codes (e.g. fishmeal, rice bran, lysine, methionine) and covers when the exemption takes effect, applying for the exemption certificate and its validity, the Schedule B reporting duties (Laporan CJ(P) Jadual B-01), when sales tax becomes payable, and FAQs.

title: e-Invoice infographics: 'Ask for an e-Invoice' campaign for individuals' tax relief claims (Malay version)
publication_date: Not stated (new on HASiL's e-Invoice infographics page 24/11/2026)
summary: Three new HASiL/MyInvois infographics remind individuals, as 2026 ends, to ask for an e-Invoice for their spending so it is easier to claim tax reliefs (e.g. laptops, books, sports equipment, medical), to keep spending records digitally in MyInvois so they are not lost, and to scan the receipt QR code to request one. Published in Malay only; no English version is listed.
